title: linear.v1 weights
description: Gym-cli LinearPolicyAi pack (not Hall). Score is bias + direct actionFeat weights + packed[i]*actionFeat[i mod 23]*W[i] (and the same pairing for each bag-hash slot). Greedy argmax. Zeros W is a legal stub and still triggers the gym anti-stall prior. Do not distill W from YodaBot/AdvancedAi. Training loop is not this file.

actionFeatDim.description: 0 pass, 1 integerNorm, 2 indexNorm, 3-18 text hash, 19-22 blueprint hash, 23 ones. Matches com.gempukku.swccgo.ai.models.LinearPolicyAi.

W.description: Length must be packedDim + bagHashDim + actionFeatDim (152 when bagHashDim is 0, 168 when bagHashDim is 16). Prefix slots are state×action interactions, not a constant added to every action. The last actionFeatDim entries are direct action weights.
